name: @operstack/audit
description: SEO, AEO and GEO audit generator: collect public signals from a site into audit.json, let an analyst or an agent fill the narrative, render the OperStack report as HTML and PDF.
author: OperStack

scripts.test: node src/test-scores.mjs && node src/test-fix.mjs && node src/test-foundation.mjs && node src/test-narrative.mjs && node src/test-prompts.mjs && node src/test-rendered.mjs && node src/test-agent-surface.mjs && node src/test-agency.mjs && node src/test-i18n.mjs examples/sample-audit.json && node bin/audit.mjs check examples/sample-audit.json && node bin/audit.mjs render examples/sample-audit.json --out /tmp/operstack-audit-sample.html
